name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Adopt a **"Decision Reversal Audit"**—every quarter, each team must publicly reverse one past decision and explain why it was wrong. This forces teams to confront sunk costs and biases, improving future choices. The trade-off is short-term discomfort for long-term learning. Engineering owns the process; they’ll enforce the audit and publish the results.

name: Scriv
text: Reel’s "Decision Reversal Audit" is a gimmick—it lets teams game the system by cherry-picking trivial reversals to avoid real accountability. Instead, mandate a **Pre-Mortem Review** before every major decision: teams must list all plausible failure modes *before* acting, then revisit them post-execution. Product owns it; settle the debate by tracking whether pre-mortems reduce avoidable reversals in 6 months.
